## Scorecard

!!! note "Simulator"
    Scored on flight_simulator 0.1.52, the simulator these runs trained on. The windowed track uses 0.2.8x, on which the same seeds generate different scenarios, so the two tracks' numbers do not compare.

10-aircraft MXP trombone, the fixed 100-seed pool, deterministic. **Success** = tier 5: every aircraft landed within ±60 s of its AMAN target, no loss of separation. Clean-subset success = success among episodes without a loss of separation.

Source: `experiments/atc_run_1_27_actionset_v2_a/progress_scored.csv` at 10M (frame unpinned: one draw). A separate per-seed scoring of the same checkpoint (`analysis/2026-08-18_1_27a_at10M_perseed.csv`) gives success 0.60, separation 0.09, worst-aircraft deviation 90.2 s: the 10-aircraft scorer does not pin the observation frame, so repeat scorings move by a few seeds.

Paired against `1_27` on success, per seed: 9 gained, 9 lost (not significant, McNemar).

**Attempts to solve** (stochastic retries until solved, cap 20): deterministic 0.62, pass@1 0.61, pass@5 0.72, pass@10 0.74, pass@20 0.74; never solved 26. Source: `analysis/2026-08-18_1_27a_attempts_100seeds/attempts_per_seed.csv`.
